name: vllm_ggml_mul_mat_vec_a8
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_ggml_mul_mat_vec_a8.py. GGML Q4_0 quantized weight x single fp32 vector matmul (batch fixed to 1): W is uint8 holding (row//32) Q4_0 blocks per row, each block = 18 bytes (fp16 scale 1.0 = 0x3C00 LE + 16 bytes of 4-bit values); X is fp32 (1, m); quant_type=2 (Q4_0); row=n. W built by gen_inputs (num_qblocks = declared W width // 18); X is plain randn. Reference calls _custom_ops.ggml_mul_mat_vec_a8 and returns its result. Default comparison over the full fp32 output. Requires vLLM at eval time.
